nom: Vacation Super Spritz SPF50 Face Mist

avis.texte: Overall, this SPF spray is good if you don't have sensitive eyes, I tend to have oily skin so sometimes my oil settles in my inner eye and on top of that with the SPF it gets into my eye and it burns throughout the whole entire day. It's very annoying

I love this but once my face would get wet my eyes would start burning. It is convenient to use especially if youre out and about an dont love rubbing sunscreen on your face to Reapply, like if youre at the beach and sandy. I do like this but beware id you have sensitive eyes. It is fragranced as well but have not had issues with the fragrance

avis.titre: Easy to use and sets makeup
avis.texte: I purchased this after makeup sunscreen, +2 other brands to try. So far, all three leave a shine/Sheen versus a matte finish. If you loke that look its fine. I have to put a little bit of setting powder after using the spray. I dont mind that. Still, Its much easier than adding a sunscreen after a medication and moisturizer and make up. My big issue with this product is that it burns if you get it on your lashes or anywhere near your eyes. I've purchased a pair of sunbed goggles to see if that helps, but I had to take all my makeup off and repeatedly wash my eyes out because the burning was so bad. I use make up setting spray ans have not experienced this so it was a big disappointment. This is ine of the few sunscreen sprays that is an SPF50 so I'll try it again with google a d see how it goes
Ive never broken out from a sunscreen like i have with this one

avis.titre: Nice product but packaging is horrible
avis.texte: Nice spray and convenient for to-go but the lid doesn't stay on well and it leaks super easily the sunscreen also dissolves the blue text on the bottle packaging causing blue ink to flake everywhere Would not recommend due to how bad packaging is

This is a must have for my summers in the Bahamas. Easy to apply, effective protection from the sun, smells great and easy to wash off. My only complaint - I wish the packaging was a little better. It tends to leak from around the sprayer so have to be careful throwing in the beach bag. Same complaint with the Chardonnay Oil. Great products though!
super convenient as someone who hated touching their face while they're out at the beach!
I have never had an allergic reaction to a face product before. This sunscreen spray made my eyelids swell up. I was able to avoid by covering my eye area up but I would not recommend this product.
I use it every day. It's amazing. It goes on light smells great and you can throw it in your bag.

i looove vacation but this is one of the products i dont like. it smells amazing just like everything else they make but it leave my eyelids really greasy. i love the packaging tho, its super convenient to carry and take out when needing to reapply.

I like to reapply my sunscreen throughout the day and I was looking for an alternative to powder but this face mist was not it. It left my face way too greasy, makeup slips and slides under it. Would not recommend.
Spritz is refreshing, easy to throw in your beach bag. Leaves my face feeling moisturized without feeling as greasy as other face spf.

I was excited to use this . I immediately sprayed on my face and instantly felt tingling sensation. Almost like little burning spots. I saw i got a bunch of small little red spots . It does smell good like coconut/ vanilla sunscreen but not too overbearing . I wanted to like it but it was not for me.

I bought this thinking it was a cute little travel size for when im at the beach and need to reapply my sunscreen but instead it burnt my eyes so bad, I had to immediately run to washroon and wash my whole face. Even then, it still stung really bad. I loved the concept of it but hated the product

I had tried the mini size of this sunscreen and loved it! Finished the whole bottle, loved it, and wanted to purchase the full bottle. Bought the bigger size and halfway thru i got a bad reaction all over my face and chest (when i only applied to my face). So i stopped using it and i had thought it was something else that caused the reaction. Tried to use it again and got the same reaction, threw it away immediately

Ive bought this 3x already as a quick sunscreen spray and go. I absolutely love it! It smells great and I can rely on it for protecting my skin. The only downside (as for any sunscreen) is if you have oily skin, be cautious of spraying in eyes. My eyes tend to burn if the sunscreen gets in them after wearing this for a couple hours. Just wipe with a baby wipe and spray again. Good to go!
I did like the convenience of the product and it DID provide sun protection however it caused my skin to break out horribly each time I tried to use it.

I was super excited about this product (the packaging mostly). my skin broke out into hives and fungal acne. I swore it could've been the forest fires/air pollution but seeing that the first ingredient is alcohol… it's a never again for me
Won't be able to use my order since it didn't arrive after ordering two weeks ago. It will arrive when I'll be away on holidays.

I haven't had an opportunity to use it for real yet but the smell is amazing, and it seems light and refreshing. It will definitely get some use during a week's long beach and pool vacation coming up! Can't wait to see if it works as well as it smells!
burns and stings my eyes so bad. doesnt feel nice on the skin either

avis.titre: Where has this been all my life
avis.texte: I absolutely hate the feel of sunscreen on my face, always have - until this product. Life changing.

I've been on the hunt all summer for a spray on SPF to go over my make up that doesn't leave me oily or greasy. This is not that one. I already have combination skin so I definitely don't need help in the dewy department. I sprayed this once over my make up to re-apply my SPF and I was in office in my freezing cubicle but we have massive windows that face me so I like to re-apply even if I don't go outside. First off the nozzle does not spray evenly and left some big splotches on my face and second I immediately felt the oily slick feeling all over. Literally ruined my make up and had to go try and blot as much off as I could considering I still had about 6 hours left of my work day. Never used it again smh.
Makes me a little oily, but it's so dry where I am that I don't care. It smells good and it's super light!!!

avis.titre: Burns and makes the face really greasy
avis.texte: First time I used this, it burned my face horribly as I sprayed it on. I was freaked out, but I tried it a second time and nothing happened. It makes the face really greasy though.
This sunscreen burns my eyes. I like the smell and it feels fine on my skin, BUT my eyes can't handle it.

I guess I'm extremely spoiled by KBeauty SPF products that you can safely use all around the eye area. I was cautious with this and shielded my eyes but it's extremely greasy and migrated into my eyes within minutes. I tried it without makeup and I don't think it would play well over makeup, especially if you're combo/oily.

I love this sunscreen. I live in Texas so sweatproof, makeup friendly, easy to reapply spf is very important and this one ticks all the boxes. Doesn't sting my eyes so I can use it hands free! *chefs kiss*
I was super excited to try after great reviews online and from friends. Sadly this product broke me out so bad after my first use.

Wanted to love this spray, but it arrived leaking everywhere and the bottle was sticky with half of the contents gone. I contacted the customer service email several times after receiving my order to ask for a replacement, and no one ever responded to me.

I've been using this product for over a year now, and I love it more than ever. The mist is totally clear and leaves no residue on your face - it also doesn't mess up your makeup. It smells SO good, like, I just want to drink it up… I have one in my car, one in my house, and one in my bag, and so should you! Sun protection is no joke!
Love this spray for face and scalp! No more burned part lines and ears! It's very easy to quickly reapply on busy kids faces too!
Ok so I am not a sensitive skin girly at all - I barely break out with most products. This spray burned and I got a million pimples all over my face and cheese. Not good.

This sunscreen smells lovely and has adorable packaging. What I did not realize is that the first ingredient is alcohol so it stings if applied over acne or any kind of injured skin. I wish the spray was more of a fine mist. You definitely have to rub it in manually to get it to provide even coverage. Not the worst but I'm not planning on repurchasing.
Clearly I must be allergic to something in this stuff because my face blew up like a balloon! It was red, hot and itchy! Took DAYS for it to subside. No thanks.
i love that its a nice fine mist spray but it burns my face but especially my lips, I always cover my eyes when I spray it on because im so afraid of it

Now this is not my primary facial SPF. (I use Elta MD UV Clear Tinted with and without makeup). I carry this in my bag for reapplication. I have very dry, sensitive and ectopic skin and have no issues with this product. I love that it does not affect my makeup. Great for pool days, long days of softball tournaments or anytime I want to top off. My girls will even use it at games etc when they don't want to slather on more sunscreen. I know everyone is different, but I have no issues with the scent bothering my skin and this has never burned my eyes. Give it shot!

I have bought the 50 SPF Super Spritz Face Mist several times and I love it. It is easy tp sprite your face in the AM and then I keep one in my purse for spritzing on the go! It is not sticky and dries quickly. It is clear and sprays like water. Dries within seconds.
Alcohol is the first inactive ingredient in this product and really stings/burns my face. It also feels quite drying. So disappointing because I love the other Vacation products.
I love the way this feels when it hits my face and the smell is amazing!

I didn't think of doing a patch test before spraying it all over my face. The next day, I got a huge rash on my cheeks and bumpy skin on the rest of my face, neck, and ears. It's not the fragrance because I used the sunscreen lotion on my arms and there was no reaction. The day after that, I sprayed it on my arm, and lo and behold there were bumps. It also burned my eyes the other day. Boo.

I love the packaging and ease of having sunscreen that doesn't ruin makeup and can travel in a purse. The problem, however, is upon application this stuff burns the skin on my face. Yes, it only lasts for a few seconds, but it's an unpleasant few. If you don't have sensitive skin, this would probably work beautifully.
I struggled with reapplication of sunscreen on top of makeup but this seems to do the trick without ruining my base!

I will not buy another sunscreen ever! The Super Spritz is easy to use, convenient, smells amazing, is refreshing, and lasts longer than I expected. I keep one in my purse at all times and will not allow myself to run out. Thanks Vacation!
It is so light, and the smell is amazing. It moisturizes my skin beautifully. I have gotten so many compliments on it, and I have recommended it to my family and friends
This is such a convenient and refreshing touch up on hot days when you are active in the sun

avis.titre: I would never buy any product from this brand
avis.texte: I had a negative reaction to this product it ruined my skin barrier. I even did a patch test which seemed to be fine. This says it has slight fragrance but it's very strong. I would not recommend this one to anyone. Be careful!
I wasn't sure if I would like it, as I hate the smell and feel of sunscreen, especially on my face. I was pleasantly surprised, its lightweight, works and smells great.

I keep this in my purse at all times. Easy to reapply and sits well over makeup. I have purchased other brands and none appy as easy as this one, in my opinion. I have had zero issues with breakouts/reactions and my skin is sensitive. I will say- I will always do a spot check prior to applying liberally and recommend everyone do.
Smells like happiness, applies like a dream. This is the only spray sunscreen I use. Nostalgic packaging to boot!

avis.titre: Smells like good times + Applies like a dream
avis.texte: This is my go-to for reapplying sunscreen to my face throughout the day and also to add some to the back of my neck/shoulders or to my arms when I'm about to go out in the sun spur-of-the-moment. I've tried other options and this one makes me happy while others stink or just don't spray well. Nostalgic packaging gets bonus points.

I have mixed feelings about this one. Overall, I like that it's SPF 50 and easy to reapply on the go, but I have to keep it upright in a plastic bag because the container leaks! The product is not greasy, but I dont feel like it fully absorbs into the skin and can be a bit sticky. That doesnt bother me when I'm at the beach, but I wouldn't use this as my every day sunscreen.

I think this might be my 5th bottle. I've tried most of the spray sunscreens at Ulta, Supergoop, Coola.. etc. this one is my favorite and the cheapest! Coola deserves honorable mention, but this formula is so similar and half the cost. Sungoop was a waste of money and the spray applicator made it useless because it was so uneven.
I wanted to love it but I broke out and itched for a week on cheeks and neck.

avis.titre: Seriously, it's a vacation in a bottle
avis.texte: I love this stuff! It smells so good and it goes on nicely under my makeup. I always want to book a cruise when I put it on. It lightens my mood every morning.
This chemically burned my skin. I hope they remove this soon not worth the pain and agony

I just dont like it. It was expensive first of all, then it smells weird but whatever i can live. Then i wear it and it burns the heck out of my skin. Mind u my skin can take a beating. This feels like bleach and chemicals and acid. I honestly dont know why it burns the face so much. Its ok on the body but feels greasy. But omg the way it feels on the face, take this off the shelf before u get in trouble vacation. Dont even ask me how it feels when u sweat it into ur eyes…..
This basically cooked my face instead of protecting me. My skilln is red, swollen, and itchy!

It's a fast and easy way to apply sunscreen. It doesn't have an unpleasant oder. A great way to finish my morning skin care routine. It can burn your eyes if you open them immediately after applying. It's best to wait a few seconds.

avis.titre: LEAKS and DESTROYED MY LOUIS VUITTON
avis.texte: Do not buy this product, it unscrews and the leakage melts things around it -- horribly tragic experience to find my Louis Vuitton entirely damaged by this on my trip.

I used to use this product daily but found an alternate sunscreen that I liked a bit more. When I ran out of my favorite sunscreen I went back to this one and it gave me a terrible chemical burn. It was not expired and stored in a cabinet.

Although it leaves you a bit doubt, I like this a lot although it can get in your eyes when you spray it so I recommend wearing sunglasses, spraying your face and then rubbing it around where your sunglasses were when you remove them

avis.titre: Never buying any other brand but vacation!
avis.texte: I'm a girl from the north country that never sees sun. Recently went to the Caribbean and didn't get a single burn, no peeling, just a nice deep tan. Not only dies this sunscreen protect but it smells amazing too!

I tried this product to reapply sunscreen over makeup. It worked well with makeup but it is super oily and would require blotting after applying. I used this two days in a row and each time it burned my eyes. I had my eyes closed and waited to reopen my eyes but it still burned. Wouldn't recommend

As a 59-year-old self-employed Uber/Lyft driver with a love for skincare and makeup, finding an SPF that fits into my busy routine is essential. The Vacation SPF 50 Super Spritz Face Mist has been a game-changer for me. It provides excellent sun protection while keeping my skin hydrated and refreshed throughout the day. I love how lightweight and non-greasy it feels, and it works perfectly over makeup, which is a huge plus for me. The blend of cucumber, aloe, and caffeine soothes and de-puffs my skin, making it look and feel calm even after long hours on the road. The luxurious, fine mist spray and its subtle tropical scent make reapplying an enjoyable experience. It's become a must-have in my skincare routine, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for convenient sun protection with added skincare benefits. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This SPF mist by Vacation combines sun protection with a nostalgic, beachy feel in the classic retro packaging. The nozzle is designed for a fine, even mist, which makes applying it quick and mess-free. This lightweight mist feels comfortable, cooling, and non-greasy, so it's easy to work into your daily routine without leaving a sticky finish. With a subtle, beachy scent, it brings a touch of summer without being overwhelming. The formula includes hydrating ingredients, avoiding the dryness that some SPF sprays can cause, and the SPF 50 provides solid broad-spectrum coverage for everything from everyday use to extended outdoor time. The mist's finish is soft, adding a gentle glow that keeps skin looking fresh but not shiny. I haven't noticed any spills in my beach bag which is great! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This thing smells SO TERRIBLE it gave me a headache. Had to wash it off and re-do my entire skincare & makeup. I thought this would be a nice option to top up on SPF but it's got such a strong horrendous chemical smell I don't think I can survive even using this on my body. I typically love scented products and use plenty of Dior, Chanel, Gucci makeup that's known to have strong fragrances so it's not even that I'm sensitive to scented products. Stay away. As I found out after purchasing, spray SPF isn't effective anyway (you need 45+ sprays to actually get the protection advertised).

I was sooooo excited for this product. Loved that it had SPF 50 in it & a spray too -- so easy and convenient. But what the heck is that smell. It's sooo overpowering. Who wants to put something THAT fragranced on their skin. Hello irritation! Goodbye skin barrier! This product is not sensitive skin friendly at all. So glad I patched tested on my arms first before spraying it all over my face. Such a let down and disappointment. Highly recommend reading the ingredient list before purchasing and putting on your skin! High alcohol content and highly fragranced. I think they need to go back to the drawing board with this product (or take it off the shelves!) Honestly. I'm that repelled. If you have acne or breakout prone skin, or any cuts or irritation on your face, or sensitive skin, or weak skin barrier.... steer clear. Don't do it. Thank me later. Ugh **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I was super excited to try this vacation 50 SPF face mist. I love that it is mist and that the mist comes out super light and evenly disperses on my face. I am able to use this on the go, as the bottle is super compactible and easy to travel with. I also love that I can use it over makeup, so it doesn't smudge it or when I am not wearing any makeup. I am very fair skinned and have a history of skin cancer, so this allows me to reapply my sunscreen throughout the day. It also helps to keep the wrinkles and sun damage/hyperpigmentation at bay. It also has a very nice scent. It is not too strong and is pleasant without being overpowering. I am excited to continue using this product and am excited to try some of their other products going forward. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I was super excited to try this vacation 50 SPF face mist. I love that it is mist and that the mist comes out super light and evenly disperses on my face. I am able to use this on the go, as the bottle is super compactible and easy to travel with. I also love that I can use it over makeup, so it doesn't smudge it or when I am not wearing any makeup. I am excited to continue using this product and am excited to try some of their other products going forward.

The Super Spritz SPF50 Face Mist by Vacation is such a convenient way to stay protected from the sun. The mist is incredibly fine and lightweight, making it easy to apply without leaving any greasy or heavy residue, even when I use it over makeup. One of my favorite things is how it doesn't disturb my makeup or leave a white cast, which can be an issue with other sunscreens. It feels refreshing when applied, almost like a cooling mist, which is a nice bonus during hot days. The compact packaging makes it easy to carry around and reapply throughout the day, no matter where I am. It's especially handy when I'm outside for long periods or need a quick top-up of SPF. The scent is light and pleasant, not overwhelming at all. I love that it offers strong sun protection without compromising comfort or convenience. It's quickly become a reliable part of my sun care routine, perfect for those days when I want quick, easy protection without any mess. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I usually don't seek out using this kind of product so I was interested in seeing if this product could somehow win me over and have me wanting to start using this type of product from now on. After my very first time trying it out, I was very pleased to see that this did not leave my skin feeling super sticky or greasy. And I was also very glad that this product comes in a bottle that's slimmer making it easier to grab and hold onto when applying it, and also makes it easy to bring along in your purse or bag. The only two issues I personally noticed with this product is the fragrance after application. It's almost overbearing. It's a very strong smell that smells artificial. I was hoping for a more subtle fragrance that was almost a earthy or clean kind of smell. The other problem I noticed was although this is a very lightweight face mist…it's almost too lightweight. I felt as if it did not spray my face evenly and leaving some places feeling more of the face mist than other parts of my face. Maybe a different type of nozzle and sprayer could fix issue? **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I'm so impressed with this spray-on sunscreen! The concept is great because it's super easy to use, and I can spray it over my makeup without ruining it. I have very sensitive, acne-prone skin, and this sunscreen is gentle enough not to cause any breakouts. It's been hard to find a sunscreen that works for me, but this one definitely does. It also works perfectly as a base for makeup no separation, and it doesn't mess with the final look. Plus, it smells amazing for a sunscreen! The light scent masks the usual strong sunscreen smell. I've been using it daily and couldn't be happier. I can't wait to take it with me on my next tropical vacation. I'm really impressed with the Vacation brand and can't wait to try more of their wonderful products! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

First off, I like the idea around it. The smell reminded me of the sunscreens I used as a child, but a little stronger smelling. The packaging is adorable looking like the throwback sunscreen and is easy enough to put in your bag. It is meant so be used for your face for even coverage, but the mist left some of my face feeling unprotected. It was a nice cooling mist that felt refreshing and helped cool me down before applying my makeup hah I personally did not get a reaction but have seen others so I would be cautious if you have sensitive skin. If you have tough skin like me I guess you dare not worry. Overall it's a good product, but I would recommend trying to rub it around before it dries to get more even coverage, but you do have to work a bit quickly. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have been waiting a long time for a product like this. It makes applying sunblock so easy and simple. I've been hearing it for years how important it is to use SPF. Especially in skin care. I haven't started doing that until this last couple of years though. Normally in my experience, products that have SPF in it make my skin feel oily or I get a white cast look going on. Sometimes it will be a whole separate product of its own and an extra step in my regimen that sometimes I feel like I don't have time for. This is literally perfect! It has a very light scent kind of like coconut maybe. It is soothing on my skin and the way the mist comes out is perfect. Not too much product, not too heavy, and really easy to use. It hasn't clogged my pores or caused my oily acne prone skin to get any acne at all! I cannot stress how important that is to me. It is also the perfect size. I usually have it right there in my purse so I can reach for it if you need to reapply. I assume it works because I haven't been sunburned being outside for long periods of time. I even use it on my kids! This is a game changer for sunscreen. You can't even tell you're wearing it! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Meet the Super Spritz SPF50 Face Mist by Vacation!KEY INGREDIENTS- Bisabolol, Aloe & Cucumber - A blend of naturally-occurring antioxidants to keep your skin soothed & calm- Caffeine - A hardworking de-puffing agent to reinvigorate your skin- Banana & Coconut - A tropical duo of nourishment and hydration to combat the drying effects of sun exposure- Shea & Maracuja Oils - Lightweight plant based oils to boost hydration & to enhance skin barrier functions- Green Tea, Vitamin E, Algae & Ferulic Acid - A refreshing antioxidant cocktail to help skin bombarded by blue light, pollution and other environmental stressors.I absolutely love this SPF50 spray sunscreen! This is my first time using a spray sunscreen. The vegan & cruelty free sunscreen dries quickly after spraying on my face. It has a light scent and feels clean and light. The spray is easy to apply and reapply wherever you go. It goes well under makeup and feels instantly fresh and protected as you go about your day. The size is perfect for throwing in my bag so I can take it everywhere. I would recommend this spray to my friends and family. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I recently tried the Vacation super spritz SPF 50 face mist. I really wanted to love this product. The concept seemed great that of a spray sunscreen that could be applied and reapplied under or over makeup. I want a huge fan of the smell/scent. Secondly unfortunately I experienced some eye irritation and burning. I didn't notice it until I started to sweat so I'm thinking it got into my eyes. I will say I'm a contact lens wearer so that might have something to do it. I also have dry eye syndrome. I wasnt to happy about the alcohol content either. I feel like with a few tweeks this could be a great staple product. I had my daughter try it and she didn't experience any eye burning or sensitivity so its probably a case by case. I hope to try it again with a better out come. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This product is super convenient to apply and I did not get sunburned when I used it. I like that it's a spray because it doesn't mess with makeup. With that being said, I wish the cap was more secure. Every time I go to pick it up it slips right off. There's no "click" mechanism like most caps. Also, I wouldn't recommend this product to those with sensitive skin or using strong actives. The first ingredient in this is alcohol, which can be really irritating and drying. I personally am using retinol and yes, I didn't get sunburned but my face was so itchy and uncomfortable. I looked at the ingredients and there it was. But if you don't have sensitive skin, I think this product would work well. Oh, and if you don't mind the cap that slips right off. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Vacation Super Spritz SPF 50 Face Mist
avis.texte: The Vacation Super Spritz SPF 50 Face Mist is a lightweight, refreshing sunscreen spray formulated to provide broad-spectrum sun protection while hydrating and soothing the skin. This sunscreen is packed with antioxidant-rich ingredients and doesn't leave a non-greasy finish or any white cast. Definitely avoid spraying on your eyes to avoid any irritation. Like its name, the sunscreen truly spritzes out of the spray bottle. I was expecting a fine mist, but no, it's literally a spray. It's fine, but just a heads up. The sunscreen is perfumed with Vacation's signature scent: a tropical mix of coconut, banana, and pineapple. Although it is pleasant and reminds me of a summer beach day, it is very strong considering it's meant to be used on the face. Overall, the Vacation Super Spritz SPF 50 Face Mist is a convenient sunscreen for reapplication on the go. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I am lucky enough to live is sunny California. I have access to the beach every day and I get beautiful sun year round. I am completely aware that because I am around sun all year I have to take care of myself. One of the ways I protect myself is by using sunscreen everyday. The sunscreen helps me from advance aging and the harmful sun rays. I have several options for sunscreens, but as a mother on the run I always look for the easiest application. Spray options are the best for me. I have tried several spray sunscreen, but I always feel oily after I use them. I came across Vacation Super Spritz SPF 50 Face Mist. This face mist has an invisible finishing that does not mess up makeup application. It dries out quickly, sets on transparent to the skin and most importantly it protects the skin from the sun. This mist does have a sunscreen fragrance to it. Now this is the part where I have to say I wanted to love this sun mist, but I unfortunately didn't. When I first sprayed it there was a huge alcohol smell that I just couldn't bypass, it smelled like I was putting hand sanitizer on my skin. Don't get me wrong I love fragranced products, but this was too much. I just can't see myself using this again.This review was collected as part of a promotion **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

As an esthetician for a decade, one of the most important skincare items to me for both personal use and for my clients is a good sunscreen. As a person who could give Snow White a run for "fairest of them all" a long lasting and effective SPF prodcut is a constant search. Vacation's Super Spritz SPF 50 face mist is one of those skincare gems that both works incredibly well, but smells AMAZING. The mist is lightweight and can be applied over makeup to make that every two hours reapplication much more convenient. The packaging is perfectly sized for on the go, as the product is wonderful for your purse or travel bag. The caffeine in the spray helps to perk up skin, while green tea soothes. The spray is specifically formulated to help sooth and hydrate the skin snd worse theatres. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

The Vacation Super Spritz SPF50 Face Mist is just a standard SPF50 spray. It is an ok product because it is a lot more convenient than bringing around a tube of sunscreen, having to slather it on your hands and rub it on your face. However, the actual product works alright with makeup, but there was a bit of pilling and dryness after using it, which wasn't ideal. Additionally, although I tested it with an acne-safe foundation base underneath, I realized I broke out just slightly after using the product for a few hours (reapplying twice in that time frame). The cap on my face mist warped and popped off as soon as I removed it from the packaging, so when bringing it along, it typically falls off exceptionally often, which is inconvenient as I fear it will shift around and spray inside my bag. I'm unsure if this is a one-off issue or if it is a universal issue with the manufacturing of the packaging. avis.titre: Smells Great, Leaves My Skin Feeling Soft
avis.texte: I would appreciate if the spritz was a little more wide. I feel like it's a little too powerful. The scent is really pleasant, it's coconut-y but not in an artificial way. avis.titre: It smells great and is easy to apply!
avis.texte: First off, Super Spritz SPF 50 Face Mist smells so good! The scent is refreshing, and the ultra-fine mist makes it incredibly easy to apply on the go. It's perfect for those busy days when you need quick sun protection without the hassle of rubbing in sunscreen. The high SPF 50 gives great coverage, and the skin-loving ingredients like vitamin E, green tea, and ferulic acid make it a solid choice for keeping your skin nourished while staying protected.I also love that it doesn't leave any white cast or residue, which is a big plus for face mists. However, there are a couple of downsides. The formula contains alcohol, and unfortunately, you can smell it right when you spray. If you're sensitive to alcohol in products, it's definitely something to be mindful of. Also, the container feels a bit fragile, so I'd be careful tossing it in a bag without some protection.Overall, I'm happy I gave it a try. I hope they consider reformulating this without alcohol in the future, but for now, it's still a convenient and effective option for sun protection on the go! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I tried this face mist while I was traveling as it was super easy to carry it around. It is also super handy whenever you are late and can be used as similar to a regular face mist. This product is perfect for people who do enjoy the greasy feel of sunscreens after application and avoid sunscreens completely.I am however not very happy with the sunscreen as I am not sure how effective a mist sunscreen would be over a cream-based one. I may reconsider buying it again but may give it a skip over other similar sunscreen products. After a longer use and if I like it, I would recommend it to my friends. Overall a good product. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I got this sunscreen spray hoping to have something that would be easy to apply and that would be gentle enough to use on my sensitive skin on my face and hands (both are super dry right now, and my hands have some cracking from the dryness). avis.titre: Possibly better for body rather than face!
avis.texte: I have very sensitive, combination skin. I try to steer away from facial products with added fragrance as much as possible. Albeit a light coconut scent, I was a bit put off by the scent of this spray. I prefer and currently use a fragrance-free sunscreen lotion for my face, which is great for my skin type. I honestly don't see the purpose of continuously using a spray for your face, especially if you wear any type of make-up. I never use any setting spray for my face. Since I wasn't too thrilled about the idea of using the product on my face and risk the chance of getting a reaction, I did use the spray on my neck.This Vacation spray is VERY wet when applied BUT dries very quickly, which is a plus. I never really know how much to spray, so I either end up soaked or feeling like I haven't applied enough. The product feels greasy/oily/sticky. That combined with the coconut scent…it's just not for me. Not as a facial mist. I'll use it in the summer for sure - when at the beach. Just not on my face ;)Side note: the packaging is not too practical. The sprayer can come loose easily if you don't tighten it enough. I actually almost spilled the entire bottle because the sprayer loosened after capping. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Additionally, I was hoping for a more pleasant scent, as the fragrance was a bit too strong for my liking, bordering on artificial.As for the SPF protection, I didn't experience any sunburn, which is great, but I would have loved to see clearer instructions on how often to reapply for maximum effectiveness. I thought it was a fluke and decided to give it another try on a different day but I had the same type of reaction. I have proven for this to work because there was a day we were under the sun for hours and thw parts of my face were not burned after but parts of my body got tanned and some parts red. So I decided to wear it on my body the next time and it works! As long as I am mindful not to have this on my face everyday and use it on my body whenever I want then I am good. If you have a sensitive skin try testing the product out first. The smell to me is not bothersome, it is a sunscreen with a little coconut smell. This has so much potential if it could be refined to be more suited for those with sensitive skin. As a beauty enthusiast, I would still recommend the product for its effectivity.
